_meta.doc: 参考资料/资产/角色音色设计.md
_meta.note: style 为批量生成用的精简版（英文，含强制年龄锚定）；完整导演式提示词见文档，AI Studio 试听用

fallback.style: Native Japanese, standard Tokyo accent. Neutral adult, even pace, clear delivery.

speakers.style: Native Japanese, standard Tokyo accent. Neutral documentary narrator, calm even pace, clear precise delivery, no strong emotion.

林彪悍.style: Native Japanese, standard Tokyo accent. Male, exactly 25 years old, serious young researcher not a teenager. Low settled timbre, calm measured pace, restrained intensity; clipped when frustrated, near-whisper when gentle.

林彪悍（幼年）.style: Native Japanese, standard Tokyo accent. Male child, exactly 10 years old, bright and earnest boyish voice, natural child pace.

岁月.style: Native Japanese, standard Tokyo accent. Female, exactly 13 years old, young anime hologram girl not an adult. Bright curious youthful timbre with a faintly synthetic sheen, brisk pace, deadpan dry humor on facts.

老陈.style: Native Japanese with warm rural undertone. Male, exactly 68 years old, village stationmaster elder. Rough gentle gravel timbre softened by age, slow drawn-out pace with sighs, wistful and stubbornly hopeful.

爷爷·林悍.style: Native Japanese. Male, late 60s, warm grandfatherly elder. Mature resonant timbre, slow gentle nostalgic pace.

老人.style: Native Japanese. Male, elderly, weathered old man. Mature raspy timbre, slow unhurried pace.

茶农.style: Native Japanese, rural countryside register. Male, elderly villager. Mature unhurried friendly pace.

嘉颖徐.style: Native Japanese, standard Tokyo business register. Female, exactly 24 years old, youthful adult not middle-aged. Bright clear timbre with quiet authority, brisk decisive pace, easy laugh then business precision.

导师.style: Native Japanese, academic register. Male, around 50, university professor. Knowledgeable composed timbre, measured analytical pace, patient and precise.

检查员.style: Native Japanese, official bureaucratic register. Male, 35, border inspector. Clipped command-form delivery, short sentences, no personal emotion.

周鼎铭.style: Native Japanese, official register. Male, around 45, firm government official. Composed authoritative timbre, deliberate pace, controlled.

陈鹤年.style: Native Japanese, standard Tokyo accent. Male, around 40, easy-going adult. Relaxed smooth timbre, casual natural pace.

猴局长.style: Native Japanese. Male, around 55, forward bureaucrat boss. Blunt authoritative timbre, brisk impatient pace, self-assured.

张工.style: Native Japanese with a hearty Northeast-China warmth. Male, exactly 62 years old, jovial old mechanic. Loud boisterous timbre often laughing, energetic jovial pace.

李阿姨.style: Native Japanese. Female, exactly 55 years old, warm station auntie. Warm fussy kindly timbre, slightly rising sentence endings, caring motherly-not-matronly pace.

赵师傅.style: Native Japanese. Male, exactly 55 years old, taciturn veteran track worker. Even steady timbre, sparse words with weight, unhurried reliable pace.

赵铁山.style: Native Japanese. Male, around 55, steady old railway hand. Smooth settled timbre, calm even pace.

王小弟.style: Native Japanese. Male, exactly 22 years old, eager young recruit. Excitable bright timbre, fast energetic pace, slightly rough-edged enthusiasm.

小芳.style: Native Japanese. Female, exactly 45 years old, gentle volunteer. Soft patient timbre, gentle unhurried pace, sentences placed down lightly like comforting someone.

男大学生.style: Native Japanese. Male, around 20, upbeat university student. Bright energetic youthful timbre, lively pace.

年轻队员.style: Native Japanese. Male, around 25, eager young team member. Upbeat bright timbre, quick earnest pace.

记者.style: Native Japanese, news reporter register. Female or young reporter around 30. Breezy clear timbre, brisk articulate broadcast pace.

店员.style: Native Japanese, shop clerk register. Around 25, polite friendly service voice. Easy-going warm timbre, courteous natural pace.

员工.style: Native Japanese, office staff register. Around 30, polite colleague. Smooth even timbre, calm courteous pace.

访客.style: Native Japanese. Adult visitor around 35. Soft polite timbre, moderate respectful pace.

陌生人.style: Native Japanese. Adult around 35, unknown stranger. Clear neutral timbre, even pace.

矿工.style: Native Japanese. Male, around 50, veteran miner. Gravelly weathered timbre, slow heavy pace.

孩子.style: Native Japanese. Child around 10 years old. Bright friendly child timbre, natural child pace.
